title: Dirge
description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] 3 X times.
Add X [gold]Souls[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
upgraded_description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] 4 X times.
Add X [gold]Souls+[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
notes: For each energy spent, summons {Summon} units. Also generates X Soul cards (upgraded to Souls+ if upgraded) and adds them to draw pile. Summoned creatures are affected by any in-play upgrades.
